name: whole-frame-only-headers-carried
reference: CCSDS 132.0-B-3 4.1.2 and 4.1.3.2; bytes computed by tools/gen/ccsds-vectors.py. A whole frame (4.1.1.1): the secondary header data, the data field, the operational control field and the frame error control field are not mapped; encode writes the 7 mapped octets. The error control value here is not a computed CRC: the pack does not read it.
